Approximation Bounds for Hierarchical Clustering: Average Linkage, Bisecting K-means, and Local Search

Benjamin Moseley, Joshua R. Wang; 24(1):1−36, 2023.

Abstract

Hierarchical clustering is a data analysis method that has been used for decades. Despite its widespread use, the method has an underdeveloped analytical foundation, which this paper addresses with an analytic framework for understanding observations seen in practice. Our framework yields tight approximation bounds for average linkage, bisecting k-means, and local search, and the bounds are shown to be tight up to constant factors. Empirical results on synthetic and real datasets confirm that the bounds predict the observed behaviour of the algorithms, and the analysis identifies the data properties that govern the gap between the optimum and the returned solution.

Published as a paper at the Journal of Machine Learning Research 24(1):1-36, 2023.
